subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Researchers built a boat using ancient methods to test whether people could have traveled between islands long ago.”?
options: Being able to study something does not automatically mean doing so without permission.
Students learned that travelers long ago also needed food, rest, news, and safety.
Slowly, they learned to match street names, turn the map, and find the river.
They learned that experimental archaeology tests possibilities by doing, not only by imagining.

本文沒有陳述「Students learned that travelers long ago also needed food, rest, news, and safety.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Slowly, they learned to match street names, turn the map, and find the river.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They learned that experimental archaeology tests possibilities by doing, not only by imagining.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
